entries.hypothesis: The keystream is PHP (5.x) mt_rand seeded by mt_srand(uint32), reduced to 0..28, canonical or pre-7.1 broken twist, offset 0, sign -1.
entries.result: Tier a: 487 core seeds decoded unfiltered + 47,549 dense seeds prefiltered; tier b: 41,680,896 uniform seeds (0.970% of 2^32, np default_rng(3301)) prefiltered at FPR 6e-4; 212,218 decodes over 4 cells (mt/php x scale29/mod29) x keyskip1+keyskip2; 0 flagged, 0 gate-3 crossers, 0 near-misses. Best screen pmax 6.856 (canonical scale29 keyskip1) vs actual-N bar 6.991 / declared 7.6342; keyskip2 best 6.426 vs 6.779 / 7.3835.
entries.coverage: tier a: 1.00 of the stated prior-dense list; tier b: 0.97% of 2^32 per twist; remaining 99.03% deferred to bigger hardware (R28-L4 queue). Prefilter power 0.72 EN, 0.71 LATIN, 0.74 DE, 0.47 NOVOWEL.
not_covered: 26-53% of planted keys dropped by the prefilter
other PHP usages (rand/srand, mt_rand(1,29), random_int, time-hash auto-seed)
legacy twist checked against R28-L4 gen28 (php 8.5.4 MT_RAND_PHP), not a PHP 5 binary
entries.positive_control: control.json all_pass: 8 plants x 8 (twist x reduction x relation) cells through the real chunk path; every prefilter-passing plant recovered (4/4,8/8,6/6,4/4,7/7,6/6,6/6,7/7); selftest vs numpy MT19937 and gen28 passes.
